intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create one independently authored, complex photorealistic render-test concept in a sunlit brutalist seed-bank accession audit, featuring one unmistakably adult woman whose facial and general appearance follows the attached reference while wardrobe semantics remain available for a later isolated assignment.

Create a photorealistic vertical full-body editorial-documentary photograph in a monumental sunlit brutalist seed-bank accession hall. One unmistakably adult woman conducts a live accession audit, lifting a translucent seed envelope into a hard clerestory sunbeam beside her silhouette and comparing its punched serial code with a glowing number set into the concrete canister wall. A narrow brass counter and open archival drawer remain lateral. She stands upright on a gridded concrete floor, arms clear of her torso, face turned toward the packet yet readable. Use the attached portrait for facial and general appearance continuity, including long dark softly waved hair and understated natural makeup. Warm sunlight cuts through cool gray concrete; airborne dust traces the beam; stainless seed capsules recede in calibrated rows; a tiny mismatch marker supplies narrative tension. The complete outfit topology, neckline, both shoulders and sleeves, waist and closure or crotch and inseam region, legs, and hems must remain fully visible and readable in one vertical full-body frame. Keep the entire figure large from head to footwear, with garment boundaries unobscured. Wardrobe specifics remain open for later assignment.

obligation.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, wardrobe, and visual style. In one still, keep a calm low-expression baseline visibly stable while one concrete, quiet practical action helps one identifiable trusted adult counterpart and leaves an already-visible helpful consequence for that same counterpart. Add only one localized warmth leak, such as slight lower-lid easing, a restrained brow release, a fractional mouth-corner softening, or reduced tension in the hand or shoulder nearest the target. Optional outward support may use economical gesture, stable upright posture, a neat simple silhouette, restrained grooming, or a muted/cool-neutral palette, but these are conventions rather than requirements. Do not assign fixed hair color, eye color, hairstyle, costume, gender, occupation, gaze direction, camera angle, or prop, and do not let expressionlessness, competence, beauty, a cool palette, or a caring object substitute for the same-target action and consequence. Preserve the counterpart's autonomy; avoid hostile denial, shy withdrawal, possessive control, broad open affection, or an abrupt personality switch.
